cases.note: Same-read ties: two Claude scoped windows map to model:opus in each read, and two Codex 'codex primary weekly' windows map to 7d; the highest used_ratio of each pair is kept and partial=true. Newer sample: the second Claude read (observed 60 s later, same exact identity) wins for 5h and model:opus even though the older values were MORE constraining; its 7d is null (not a value), so the older 7d sample stays with its own observed_at. Only one source can be emitted today (the usage-worker is unbound), so the newer sample is a newer hotseat-cli read; the rule is source-independent.

cases.note: Read 1 (T0) has model:opus 0.8 and 5h 0.9, more constraining but 760 s old (stale) at serve time. Read 2 (T0+700 s, same exact identity) is fresh: its 5h 0.3 and its model:opus win, and read 2 itself had two opus samples (0.2, 0.3), so 0.3 is kept and partial=true. The stale samples never displace the fresh ones. Read 2's 7d is null (not a sample), so read 1's 7d is retained with its own observed_at and stale=true. Nothing is merged.
